/**
 * Returns a new array containing all elements except the last one from the input array.
 * If the input array is empty or has only one element, the function returns an empty array.
 *
 * @template T The type of elements in the array.
 * @param arr - The input array.
 * @returns A new array containing all but the last element of the input array.
 *
 * @example
 * const arr = [1, 2, 3, 4];
 * const result = initial(arr);
 * // result will be [1, 2, 3]
 */

contract.method: source-reviewed curated specification; not automatic extraction
contract.description: Return a new array containing all input elements except the last, preserving order and duplicates. Empty and single-element inputs produce an empty array.
contract.domain: The input is a dense array of at most 128 finite numbers, each between -1000 and 1000. The input must not be modified. Return a fresh array even when its contents are unchanged.
contract.outputRole: fresh sequence without the last element
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.
